name: FreeBand
subtitle: An on-device WHOOP companion, with Traditional Chinese support.
description: FreeBand public iOS beta. Independent of WHOOP. Noncommercial use; original author credits are included in the repository notices.

apps.name: FreeBand
apps.subtitle: Your WHOOP strap, your iPhone, your data.
apps.localizedDescription: Connect a WHOOP strap over Bluetooth. View heart rate, sleep, recovery and trends, and keep a food log with Taiwanese presets. Core tracking works on-device without a FreeBand account. Optional network features are described in the installation guide.

versions.localizedDescription: FreeBand 11.8.1, public beta (build 416). Install with AltStore Classic or another compatible sideloader. Back up before updating; weight-loss logs are not included in .noopbak backups.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: FreeBand connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: FreeBand reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: FreeBand writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FreeBand records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FreeBand uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: FreeBand reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FreeBand transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
